entries.speaker: Motivated First-Year
entries.en: Man, I saw someone real pretty[n]around here! She was like a model!

entries.speaker: Energetic First-Year
entries.en: Do you mean Takamaki-senpai? She's[n]famous. I heard she used to live[n]abroad and even models for ads...

entries.speaker: Motivated First-Year
entries.en: I wish I could get to know her, but she[n]seems almost impossible to approach.

entries.speaker: Energetic First-Year
entries.en: Agreed. She totally stands out too.[n]Apparently some third-years have[n]to keep an eye on her.

entries.speaker: Motivated First-Year
entries.en: What!? How scary... I guess that's[n]what happens if you stand out as[n]much as she does...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Finally found you. I got a favor to ask.

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: S-Sakamoto... I knew you'd show up[n]for me...

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: Look, I have to go cheer for[n]Mr. Kamoshida, so it'd be[n]great if this could wait till later.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: He's the one that gave you those injuries,[n]right? We wanna accuse him, so we need[n]victims.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Do you really wanna let that bastard run[n]free? I'm beggin' you to help us out!
Help us.
Don't ignore this.

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: ...Sorry, but you'll have to look for[n]someone else.

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: I want to graduate without any issues...[n]I'd rather not end up like you.

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: If I get on Mr. Kamoshida's bad side,[n]I won't get away. You know how[n]influential he is, right...?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit, his mouth's stayin' shut.[n]All 'cause of that bastard's dirty tricks...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess we just gotta move on to[n]the next one. I'm not givin' up...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: It ain't workin'. Everybody just shuts up[n]the moment we mention Kamoshida's[n]name.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dammit... What're we supposed to do!?
Let's rest for a bit.
This is all your fault.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yeah, I guess it wouldn't hurt takin'[n]a breather and rethinkin' our strategy[n]for now.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, let's go grab something to drink[n]down in the courtyard.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Don't say that. You're the one[n]with the criminal record...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Er, I mean arrest record. Not criminal.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Sorry.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: C'mon, I'll buy you some juice to make up[n]for it. Let's head down to the courtyard.

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: Why are you trying to stir up trouble?[n]Everyone is okay with things as they are...

entries.speaker: Agitated Volleyball Player
entries.en: You should know better than anyone...[n]The status quo is the way to go.
